author: blu
body: Proves Nevinyrral's Disk: destroy all artifacts, creatures, and enchantments (lands survive). "Destroy all artifacts, creatures, and enchantments." compiles to DestroyAllNonland both as a spell effect and as the Disk's activated ability. Resolving it wipes every non-land permanent off the battlefield. The AI treats it as a board sweeper. Here a board of a bear, a Mox, and a Crusade is cleared, leaving only the Forest.
